LightningComponentBundle.description: GC-3483 Sprint 8. Shared calendar for selecting a primary requested date, an optional backup date, and the event duration.

property.name: excludeRequestId
property.label: Request being edited
property.description: GC-3483. Leave blank when creating a request. When updating dates, set this to the current request so it stays visible and is not a conflict with itself.

property.name: primaryDate
property.label: Primary Requested Date
property.description: GC-3483. Primary date selected on the calendar.

property.name: backupDate
property.label: Backup Requested Date
property.description: GC-3483. Backup date selected on the calendar.

property.name: hasConflict
property.label: Has Date Conflict
property.description: GC-3483. True when a selected date already has another event.

property.name: businessJustification
property.label: Business Justification
property.description: GC-3483. Required when a selected date already has another event.

property.name: eventDuration
property.label: Event Duration (Days)
property.description: GC-3483 Sprint 8. Number of days the demonstration is available to the customer. Minimum 1.
